tasks.subject: Task 1: ConId/VarId lexer split
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Split the single VarId token into ConId (uppercase-initial) and VarId (lowercase/_-initial), reclassifying every grammar position.

**Files:** grammar/Wok.cf; regenerate src/GeneratedParser/Wok/{Abs.hs,Lex.x,Par.y,Print.hs,Layout.hs,ErrM.hs}; create test/examples/12-conid-split.wok + golden and test/examples/13-data-lowercase-error.wok + golden.

**Regen:** bnfc --haskell -d -p GeneratedParser --text-token -o src grammar/Wok.cf

**Verify:** cabal test

```json:metadata
{"files": ["grammar/Wok.cf", "src/GeneratedParser/Wok/Abs.hs", "src/GeneratedParser/Wok/Lex.x", "src/GeneratedParser/Wok/Par.y", "src/GeneratedParser/Wok/Print.hs", "src/GeneratedParser/Wok/Layout.hs", "src/GeneratedParser/Wok/ErrM.hs", "test/examples/12-conid-split.wok", "test/golden/12-conid-split.expected", "test/examples/13-data-lowercase-error.wok", "test/golden/13-data-lowercase-error.expected"], "verifyCommand": "cabal test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["ConId and VarId tokens defined with disjoint first chars", "DData/ConDef/PApp use ConId; APCon/TCon/ECon added", "bnfc and cabal build succeed", "pre-existing tests pass unchanged", "data foo = Bar is a parse error"]}
```
